collection.description: Stage 2 — экран SKU Performance. Источник: wb_mart.V_DASH_SKU_DAILY (грейн сутки × nm_id). Все ratio — ratio-of-sums. Показатели «до себестоимости»: REF_COGS отсутствует.
collection.name: 02 SKU Performance

stages.native:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT MIN(day) AS d1, MAX(day) AS d2
  FROM `wb_mart.V_DASH_SKU_PERFORMANCE_V2_DAILY`
  WHERE {{day}}
),
t AS (SELECT * FROM `wb_mart.TVF_SKU_PERFORMANCE_V2_PERIOD`((SELECT d1 FROM b), (SELECT d2 FROM b))),
sel AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT nm_id FROM `wb_mart.V_DASH_SKU_PERFORMANCE_V2_DAILY`
  WHERE TRUE [[AND {{sku}}]]
),
r AS (SELECT * FROM t WHERE NOT is_portfolio_total AND nm_id IN (SELECT nm_id FROM sel)),
a AS (
  SELECT
    ANY_VALUE(period_from) AS period_from, ANY_VALUE(period_to) AS period_to, ANY_VALUE(period_days) AS len,
    ANY_VALUE(min_reliable_units) AS min_units, COUNT(*) AS skus,
    SUM(cur_orders_gross_units) AS c_orders_gross_units, SUM(prv_orders_gross_units) AS p_orders_gross_units, SUM(cur_orders_gross_seller_price_rub) AS c_orders_gross_seller_price_rub, SUM(prv_orders_gross_seller_price_rub) AS p_orders_gross_seller_price_rub, SUM(cur_orders_cancelled_units) AS c_orders_cancelled_units, SUM(prv_orders_cancelled_units) AS p_orders_cancelled_units, SUM(cur_buyout_units) AS c_buyout_units, SUM(prv_buyout_units) AS p_buyout_units, SUM(cur_cohort_buyout_orders) AS c_cohort_buyout_orders, SUM(prv_cohort_buyout_orders) AS p_cohort_buyout_orders, SUM(cur_cohort_resolved_orders) AS c_cohort_resolved_orders, SUM(prv_cohort_resolved_orders) AS p_cohort_resolved_orders, SUM(cur_cohort_unresolved_orders) AS c_cohort_unresolved_orders, SUM(prv_cohort_unresolved_orders) AS p_cohort_unresolved_orders, SUM(cur_cohort_conflict_orders) AS c_cohort_conflict_orders, SUM(prv_cohort_conflict_orders) AS p_cohort_conflict_orders, SUM(cur_ads_attributed_rub) AS c_ads_attributed_rub, SUM(prv_ads_attributed_rub) AS p_ads_attributed_rub, SUM(cur_buyout_seller_price_rub) AS c_buyout_seller_price_rub, SUM(prv_buyout_seller_price_rub) AS p_buyout_seller_price_rub, SUM(cur_fin_seller_price_rub) AS c_fin_seller_price_rub, SUM(prv_fin_seller_price_rub) AS p_fin_seller_price_rub, SUM(cur_fin_sale_units) AS c_fin_sale_units, SUM(prv_fin_sale_units) AS p_fin_sale_units, SUM(cur_fin_return_units) AS c_fin_return_units, SUM(prv_fin_return_units) AS p_fin_return_units, SUM(cur_contribution_after_cogs_rub) AS c_contribution_after_cogs_rub, SUM(prv_contribution_after_cogs_rub) AS p_contribution_after_cogs_rub, SUM(cur_contribution_before_cogs_rub) AS c_contribution_before_cogs_rub, SUM(prv_contribution_before_cogs_rub) AS p_contribution_before_cogs_rub, SUM(cur_credited_for_goods_rub) AS c_credited_for_goods_rub, SUM(prv_credited_for_goods_rub) AS p_credited_for_goods_rub,
    MAX(cur_orders_cov_days) AS c_orders_cov_days, MAX(prv_orders_cov_days) AS p_orders_cov_days, MAX(cur_sales_cov_days) AS c_sales_cov_days, MAX(prv_sales_cov_days) AS p_sales_cov_days, MAX(cur_ads_cov_days) AS c_ads_cov_days, MAX(prv_ads_cov_days) AS p_ads_cov_days, MAX(cur_finance_cov_days) AS c_finance_cov_days, MAX(prv_finance_cov_days) AS p_finance_cov_days, MAX(cur_storage_cov_days) AS c_storage_cov_days, MAX(prv_storage_cov_days) AS p_storage_cov_days, MAX(cur_finance_provisional_days) AS c_finance_provisional_days, MAX(prv_finance_provisional_days) AS p_finance_provisional_days, MAX(cur_price_chain_missing_days) AS c_price_chain_missing_days, MAX(prv_price_chain_missing_days) AS p_price_chain_missing_days, MAX(cur_current_days) AS c_current_days, MAX(prv_current_days) AS p_current_days, MAX(cur_days_present) AS c_days_present, MAX(prv_days_present) AS p_days_present,
    SUM(cur_cogs_missing_sku_days) AS c_cogs_missing_sku_days
  FROM r
),
k AS (
  SELECT a.*,
    -- сопоставимость окон по метрике: одинаковое число покрытых суток, текущее окно покрыто целиком
    (c_orders_cov_days = p_orders_cov_days AND c_orders_cov_days = len)                              AS orders_cmp,
    (c_sales_cov_days = p_sales_cov_days AND c_sales_cov_days = len)                                 AS sales_cmp,
    (c_ads_cov_days = p_ads_cov_days AND c_ads_cov_days = len AND c_sales_cov_days = len AND p_sales_cov_days = len) AS drr_cmp,
    (c_finance_cov_days = p_finance_cov_days AND c_finance_cov_days = len
     AND c_ads_cov_days = len AND p_ads_cov_days = len)                                              AS econ_cmp,
    -- Зрелость когорты для ПОДАЧИ: нет заказов без исхода ИЛИ окно закончилось ≥ 21 дня назад
    -- (p99 «заказ → выкуп» = 18 дней, Phase A §F). Флаг Phase B cohort_mature остаётся строгим.
    (c_cohort_unresolved_orders + c_cohort_conflict_orders = 0
     OR DATE_DIFF(CURRENT_DATE('Europe/Moscow'), period_to, DAY) >= 21)                              AS c_cohort_mature,
    (p_cohort_unresolved_orders + p_cohort_conflict_orders = 0
     OR DATE_DIFF(CURRENT_DATE('Europe/Moscow'), DATE_SUB(period_from, INTERVAL 1 DAY), DAY) >= 21)  AS p_cohort_mature,
    -- Надёжность сравнения (порог Phase B min_reliable_units): база ≥ порога в ОБОИХ окнах. Это только пометка
    -- «мало данных» рядом с фактическим изменением; изменение не скрывается (display ≠ alert eligibility).
    (IFNULL(c_orders_gross_units, 0) >= min_units AND IFNULL(p_orders_gross_units, 0) >= min_units)   AS orders_rel,
    (IFNULL(c_buyout_units, 0) >= min_units AND IFNULL(p_buyout_units, 0) >= min_units)               AS buyouts_rel,
    (IFNULL(c_cohort_resolved_orders, 0) >= min_units AND IFNULL(p_cohort_resolved_orders, 0) >= min_units) AS cohort_rel,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(c_orders_gross_seller_price_rub, NULLIF(c_orders_gross_units, 0)) AS c_price,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(p_orders_gross_seller_price_rub, NULLIF(p_orders_gross_units, 0)) AS p_price,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(c_cohort_buyout_orders, NULLIF(c_cohort_resolved_orders, 0))      AS c_rate,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(p_cohort_buyout_orders, NULLIF(p_cohort_resolved_orders, 0))      AS p_rate,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(c_ads_attributed_rub, NULLIF(c_buyout_seller_price_rub, 0))       AS c_drr,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(p_ads_attributed_rub, NULLIF(p_buyout_seller_price_rub, 0))       AS p_drr,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(c_contribution_after_cogs_rub, NULLIF(c_fin_seller_price_rub, 0)) AS c_margin,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(p_contribution_after_cogs_rub, NULLIF(p_fin_seller_price_rub, 0)) AS p_margin,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(c_contribution_after_cogs_rub, NULLIF(c_fin_sale_units - c_fin_return_units, 0)) AS c_per_buyout
  FROM a
)
SELECT CONCAT(IFNULL(CONCAT(CONCAT(IF(ROUND(c_contribution_after_cogs_rub) < 0, '−', ''), REPLACE(FORMAT("%'d", ABS(CAST(ROUND(c_contribution_after_cogs_rub) AS INT64))), ',', ' ')), ' ₽'), '—'), '  ·  ', IFNULL(CASE WHEN NOT IFNULL(econ_cmp, FALSE) THEN 'н/с' WHEN (c_contribution_after_cogs_rub) IS NULL OR (p_contribution_after_cogs_rub) IS NULL THEN '—' ELSE CONCAT(IF(ROUND(((c_contribution_after_cogs_rub) - (p_contribution_after_cogs_rub)), 0) > 0, '↑ ', IF(ROUND(((c_contribution_after_cogs_rub) - (p_contribution_after_cogs_rub)), 0) < 0, '↓ ', '→ ')), CONCAT(IF(ROUND(ABS(((c_contribution_after_cogs_rub) - (p_contribution_after_cogs_rub)))) < 0, '−', ''), REPLACE(FORMAT("%'d", ABS(CAST(ROUND(ABS(((c_contribution_after_cogs_rub) - (p_contribution_after_cogs_rub)))) AS INT64))), ',', ' ')), ' ₽', IF(buyouts_rel, '', ' · мало данных')) END, '—')) AS kpi FROM k

description: Сколько товары заработали: начисление WB за товар минус прямая логистика, доступное хранение по товару, атрибутированная реклама и себестоимость. Общие расходы аккаунта (тарифная опция, штрафы, утилизация, прочие удержания) по товарам не распределяются, поэтому сумма не равна результату Executive. Это не прибыль. «мало данных» — меньше 10 выкупов в одном из периодов: изменение фактическое, но выводы делать рано; сигналов «Требуют внимания» по нему нет.
name: SKU V2 · Вклад SKU после себестоимости
